scope: Stop-only retransmission reliability fix on manual zero-excitation Q0; not controller or guard retuning
export: Same immutable63488-byte blob,3968chunks16bytes, two copies/chunk per pass. Full ascending pass then full descending pass. I89=4 only after BOTH; final I90=0. No receive command, new motor run, baud/channel/active-stream change.
captureStop: I88=4440 AND I89=4 AND I90=0 then at least5seconds; preserve history from before8s boot-start
decoder: Require exact67822/4489/HW6/method11, no session reset, everychunk>=2 byte-identical copies, wholeCRC32 and5s completion tail. Motion or transition sequence gaps invalidate recording. Stop-only gaps may be recovered ONLY when all chunks/copies/CRC pass. Missing bytes never filled. Latched faults still invalidate motion.
changeInGapPolicy: Old67821 qualification rejected all sequence gaps. New67822 explicitly permits stop-only gaps reconstructed and verified from retransmission. This is a predefined transport repair criterion, not a performance threshold change.
control: Exactly same ordinaryBLNN core/filter/initialization/AW/HW6/1200count limits/2mm20s reference/physical guards.8s healthy one-shot boot-start and manual emergency-stop workflow unchanged.
limitations: Two passes are not PC acknowledgement or a guarantee. Deliberate or persistent loss in both passes remains failure; mechanical delivery/torque and independent carriage displacement are not certified. Firmware compile/native tests do not qualify on-board timing.
